artworks.title: The Portrait Bust
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical bust in a lush, leafy environment. The scene is intricately detailed, with the bust placed atop a plinth which is surrounded by dense foliage and branches cascading with leaves. The background is filled with finely etched textures of leaves and stems. On the plinth, there is an engraved dedication that reads "Les Soirees de Rome" with additional text below. In the foreground, a couple of jars rest amid the vegetation. The drawing uses elaborate lines and cross-hatching techniques to illustrate depth and detail in an ancient garden or Roman setting.

artworks.title: The Ancient Temple
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view of an old stone building with circular columns and an arch. The sky is filled with textured clouds. A bell tower is visible on the roof, slightly off-center. The etching style includes detailed cross-hatching for shadows and textures. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of sepia or brown tones. Two figures in robes are conversing on stone steps leading up to the building. Stone architecture and a cross are visible beyond them, framed by arched greenery. The background features swirling clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: The Sarcophagus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical monument near a pyramid. The scene depicts an ornate sarcophagus or monument, adorned with carved figures, set in front of a large pyramid structure, all surrounded by lush trees. Two individuals are engaged in conversation in the foreground, with one seated figure resting nearby. The sky is gently sketched with clouds, adding depth to the composition. The detailed etching style captures the grandeur and timelessness of the ancient structure and its surroundings.

artworks.title: The Triumphal Arch
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins with two figures on a stone platform. One figure is standing with a staff, while the other is seated or leaning against the stone. Intricate etching lines create textures and depth. In the background, there is an archway framing the sky with clouds. The horizon is obscured by ruins and foliage. The artwork is in black and white, emphasizing the historical scene with light and shadow contrast. Foliage on the right contrasts with the architecture.

artworks.title: The Post
artworks.description: The image shows a pair of individuals near a wooden structure. A tall wooden pole with a box and pulley system is on the left side. A rope hangs from the box, and a ladder leans against the pole. Nearby, the couple stands talking, with one person holding a hat. In the background, a dense line of trees spans the horizon under a cloudy sky. The artwork features detailed etching with fine lines and crosshatching, creating texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of sepia and black.

artworks.title: Two Scouts
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Nancy Voorhees, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows two men on horseback in military uniforms. They are sitting upright on their horses in an outdoor setting surrounded by trees under a cloudy sky. The man on the right has a mustache and wears a hat, while the other man also wears a hat. They are both dressed in gray jackets, knee-length boots, and the man on the right has a red scarf around his neck. They are both holding the reins of their horses. The ground is earthy with foliage.

artworks.title: Albert Einstein
artworks.description: The image is a charcoal sketch of a man with notable features, including deep-set eyes, a prominent mustache, and wavy hair brushed back from his forehead. He is wearing a collared shirt, tie, and suit jacket. There are no additional objects in the plain background. The artist's signature is visible in the bottom corner.

artworks.title: Moonrise on an Empty Shore
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: Drawn and painted with ink and graphite, boulders and rocks painted in hazy, soft tones of fawn and sable brown fill the bottom third of this horizontal landscape drawing. Placid water leads back to a horizon that blends with the bone-brown sky above. A pale, cream-white full moon hangs low in the sky near the center of the composition.

artworks.title: A Triumphal Procession in Ancient Rome
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite and black chalk
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical scene in an ancient city. The drawing features architectural elements such as columns and statues. In the foreground, there are figures engaged in activity. The background shows a building with steps and columns, and tall structures that resemble columns with statues on top. The use of shading and line work conveys movement and activity.

artworks.title: La promenade du Critique influent
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men from the waist up. The central figure stands upright and reads from a piece of paper. The central person has a large mustache and sideburns, and wears a tall hat. He is dressed in a formal suit with a vest and bow tie under a coat. Surrounding him are several men with a variety of hats. A man on the left appears to be leaning forward, holding a top hat, while another on the right gestures with one hand. The background consists of crowded paintings and frames. There are no visible jewelry pieces on any individuals.

artworks.title: Alpheus and Arethusa
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical figures amidst swirling clouds. The scene depicts several mythological beings, prominently featuring winged cherubs and a figure holding a staff with a trident. The composition is intricately filled with sweeping, cloudy forms. One central figure appears to be in motion, rising out of the clouds, another figure seems to be seated atop the vapor. The detailed linework renders a contrast between the earthbound elements and the dynamic aerial scene above. The scene is set against a background that includes rocky and barren terrain and trees, framing the action in an otherworldly landscape.

artworks.title: The Death of Priam
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown washes over graphite on tan laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with several figures in dramatic postures. The drawing features a group of figures that appear to be engaged in an intense interaction. One figure is shown leaning forward with a hand raised to their face. Others are depicted standing nearby, dressed in flowing garments and positioned in dynamic poses. The lines are fluid and expressive, giving a sense of movement to the scene. The overall tone is sepia, created with ink and wash.

artworks.title: Shell (Vasum ceramicum)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edward William Carter and Hannah Locke Carter, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching of a large seashell with spiky, protruding edges. The color palette consists of shades of black and white. The shell is positioned centrally on a plain background, lying horizontally with its pointed end directed towards the right side of the image. The texture and intricate patterns on the shell are carefully depicted, contrasting sharply against the lighter background.

artworks.title: Shell (Murex brandaris)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edward William Carter and Hannah Locke Carter, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a large seashell with multiple spikes and ridges against a plain textured background. The shell is detailed and colored in various shades of black, gray, and white. It is oriented with its pointed end extending towards the left and its larger, spiky section slightly elevated to the right, centered in the composition.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Sebastian
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown and gray wash heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man tied to a large tree or post. He is standing upright with his arms raised above his head and bound at the wrists. He appears calm with his eyes closed, medium-length curly hair, and is mostly unclothed except for a cloth around his waist. Four small cherubic figures with curly hair and wings are around him, with two on each side near his feet. The background includes draped fabric and trees in the distance.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Sebastian
artworks.description: The image shows a man with his hands stretched above his head and fastened to a column. He has a pained expression on his face, sharp facial features, and curly hair. His torso is bare with a cloth around his waist. Surrounding him are winged cherubs holding ropes. In the background, there is a curtain and barren trees. The image has a classical, dramatic style with detailed engravings.

artworks.title: Cetara on the Gulf of Salerno
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 36.6 x 52.7 cm (14 7/16 x 20 3/4 in.)
overall (mat size): 61 x 76.2 cm (24 x 30 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift in honor of Paul Mellon by the Patrons' Permanent Fund with additional support from Dick and Ritchie Scaife, Catherine Mellon Conover, Rachel Mellon Walton, Mr. and Mrs. James M. Walton and an anonymous donor
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront with mountains in the background. The viewpoint is elevated, showing the water, landscape, and horizon. Buildings are visible near the water, and mountains loom in the distance. The painting style is soft and dreamy, emphasizing a serene atmosphere with blended brushstrokes. Colors include blues, grays, greens, whites, and light grays, creating a calm and cool mood.

artworks.title: Joseph Vien
artworks.artist: Simon Charles Miger after Adélaïde Labille-Guiard
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man. He is positioned frontally with his head turned slightly to the left. The man appears middle-aged, with styled, wavy hair and a composed expression. He is dressed in formal attire from an earlier time period and is framed within a large oval border with a detailed etched pattern. Below the portrait is a sculpted surface with inscribed text and a decorative design. The background consists of a finely detailed, cross-hatched pattern.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher Giving His Hand to the Infant Jesus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 24.7 x 18.5 cm (9 3/4 x 7 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image consists of two figures – one adult and one child. The adult is standing with a staff in hand, reaching out to the child. The adult has curly hair, a beard, and a robust build, draped in loose clothing. The child is reclining on a rock with an illuminated halo around the head and reaching towards the adult. The setting is outdoors with trees and foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Tête de Putiphar (Potiphar's Wife)
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black on blue laid paper; laid down to engraved sheet
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of a person's bust, primarily focusing on the head and shoulders. The person is facing sideways with a slightly upward gaze. The facial features are delicate, with a slightly open mouth and a pronounced chin. The person's hair is styled in an intricate updo with curls and a ribbon or band. They are wearing a garment with a visible neckline, and the background has subtle shading. The image is framed with a decorative border.

artworks.title: Saint Gregoire I Delivering Souls from Purgatory
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 55.5 x 38.3 cm (21 7/8 x 15 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene with numerous figures and flowing clouds. The image shows figures, some with wings, floating among swirling clouds. At the bottom, figures seem to struggle or reach upwards, while above, others ascend effortlessly, aided by winged beings. Intricate detailing of drapery and clouds creates a vibrant sense of movement. There is a prominent figure on the right holding either a staff or a sword. The scene captures a blend of ascension and struggle through the dramatic poses and expressions. The drawing is detailed with textures and intricate linework enhancing the sense of motion and drama.

artworks.title: Flora and Mercury
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to and within plate mark): 25.5 x 18.9 cm (10 1/16 x 7 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure reclining on a cloud surrounded by other celestial elements. The scene depicts a celestial setting. The central figure is sitting on a bed of clouds with their back turned and large wings. Another winged figure with curly hair is above them. There are smaller winged figures around them, possibly cherubs, contributing to the heavenly theme. The line work is intricate, with attention to the curves and folds of the wings and clouds, creating a sense of depth and movement.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image shows a person's upper body and face. The individual is resting their head on their left hand while looking directly at the viewer. They have a smooth, rounded face with prominent eyes and full lips, and styled hair. They are dressed in an elaborate coat with large buttons, braid trimmings, and sheer, ruffled fabric at the neck and cuffs. In their right hand, they hold an artist's tool over a surface. The background is plain and dark, emphasizing the person's features and attire.

artworks.title: The Visitation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 10.8 x 8.1 cm (4 1/4 x 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing closely together, depicted from head to toe. Both people are standing upright, slightly leaning toward each other with their heads touching gently. The person on the left is wearing a headscarf or veil covering their hair completely, and their facial features are delicately defined. They are wearing a flowing robe. The individual on the right has long, wavy hair that falls past their shoulders, with sharp facial features. They are also dressed in long, draped garments and holding a staff resting against their shoulder. The background has minimal detail, with horizontal lines suggesting a textured landscape.
